name: KMC Speciality Hospitals (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, KMC Speciality Hospitals (India) is in the healthcare sector running, operating, maintaining multi-specialty hospital in Trichy. The company belongs to the Kauvery Hospitals group. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of rendering medical and healthcare services.
keyPoints:
Part of Kauvery Group Hospitals
The company is a super-specialty hospital based in Trichy, belonging to the “Kauvery Hospitals group”. The group has more than 2250 beds of multispecialty hospital chains at 12 locations, providing facilities for 1 lakh per year of IP patients and 10 lakhs per year of OP patients. The group is doing more than 600 transplants, 1000+ Joint Replacements, and 1 lakh + Kidney procedures per year. [1] [2]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company's median sales growth is 16.9% of last 10 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
